de-a1-hallo.title: Introductions
de-a1-hallo.summary: Teaches you to say your name, where you are from and where you live.

de-a1-wie-gehts.title: Asking how someone is
de-a1-wie-gehts.summary: Teaches you to ask how someone is, say how you are and put the question back.

de-a1-du-oder-sie.title: du or Sie
de-a1-du-oder-sie.summary: Teaches you who to address informally, who formally, and how the verb changes.

de-a1-woher.title: Where are you from
de-a1-woher.summary: Teaches you to use question words to ask where someone is from, where they live and what something is.

de-a1-sprachen.title: Languages
de-a1-sprachen.summary: Teaches you to ask about languages with the verb first and say which ones you speak.

de-a1-zahlen.title: Numbers 1-100
de-a1-zahlen.summary: Teaches you to count to a hundred, give your phone number and ask a price.

de-a1-alphabet.title: Spelling
de-a1-alphabet.summary: Teaches you to spell your name and ask how a word is written.

de-a1-beruf.title: Jobs
de-a1-beruf.summary: Teaches you to say your profession, what you do and which company you work for.

de-a1-alter.title: Age and birthplace
de-a1-alter.summary: Teaches you to give your age, ask someone else's and say where you were born.

de-a1-formular.title: Filling in a form
de-a1-formular.summary: Teaches you to understand and answer the name, address and postcode questions on an official form.

de-a1-familie.title: My family
de-a1-familie.summary: Teaches you to introduce family members and how the possessive changes with the noun.

de-a1-geschwister.title: Siblings
de-a1-geschwister.summary: Teaches you to talk about your siblings and how a masculine noun changes as an object.

de-a1-kein.title: Negating with kein
de-a1-kein.summary: Teaches you to say that something is not there, with the ready-made refusals of daily life.

de-a1-haustiere.title: Pets
de-a1-haustiere.summary: Teaches you to introduce your pet and say its name and how old it is.

de-a1-fotos.title: People in the photo
de-a1-fotos.summary: Teaches you to ask about people in a photo and use 'our' and 'her' possessives.

de-a1-plural.title: Plurals
de-a1-plural.summary: Teaches you why German plurals have to be learnt and how they work with numbers and quantities.

de-a1-aussehen.title: Appearance
de-a1-aussehen.summary: Teaches you to describe someone's appearance and that traits and body parts take different verbs.

de-a1-freunde.title: Friends
de-a1-freunde.summary: Teaches you how the verb ending changes when you talk about someone else.

de-a1-nicht.title: Negating with nicht
de-a1-nicht.summary: Teaches you to negate verbs and adjectives, and where the negation goes in the sentence.

de-a1-familienfest.title: A family gathering
de-a1-familienfest.summary: Teaches you to plan a family gathering: who is coming and who is bringing what.

de-a1-cafe.title: At the cafe
de-a1-cafe.summary: Teaches you to order politely and ask for the bill.

de-a1-fruehstueck.title: Breakfast
de-a1-fruehstueck.summary: Teaches you to say what you eat and drink for breakfast.

de-a1-imbiss.title: At the snack bar
de-a1-imbiss.summary: Teaches you to order quickly at a snack bar, ask the price and ask for it to take away.

de-a1-restaurant.title: At the restaurant
de-a1-restaurant.summary: Teaches you to order politely in a restaurant and pay the bill.

de-a1-lieblingsessen.title: Favourite foods
de-a1-lieblingsessen.summary: Teaches you to say what you enjoy eating and what you prefer.

de-a1-supermarkt.title: At the supermarket
de-a1-supermarkt.summary: Teaches you to say what you need and ask for what you are looking for.

de-a1-mengen.title: Quantities
de-a1-mengen.summary: Teaches you to say how much you want: kilos, bottles and pieces.

de-a1-kochen.title: Cooking together
de-a1-kochen.summary: Teaches you to say who is doing what in the kitchen.

de-a1-allergie.title: Allergies and preferences
de-a1-allergie.summary: Teaches you to say politely what you do not eat and what you are allergic to.

de-a1-einladung-essen.title: A dinner invitation
de-a1-einladung-essen.summary: Teaches you to accept an offer at the table, decline politely and praise the food.

de-a1-mein-tag.title: Daily routine
de-a1-mein-tag.summary: Teaches you to describe how a day goes: it begins, you work, you sleep.

de-a1-uhrzeit.title: Telling the time
de-a1-uhrzeit.summary: Teaches you to ask and tell the time, and shows how German builds the half hour.

de-a1-trennbar.title: Separable verbs
de-a1-trennbar.summary: Teaches you verbs whose prefix moves to the end: aufstehen, einkaufen, anrufen.

de-a1-wochentage.title: Days of the week
de-a1-wochentage.summary: Teaches you the days of the week and the prepositions that separate day from time.

de-a1-v2.title: The verb in second place
de-a1-v2.summary: Teaches you that the verb keeps its place when a time expression opens the sentence.

de-a1-morgenroutine.title: The morning in order
de-a1-morgenroutine.summary: Teaches you to describe your morning in sequence: first, then, after that.

de-a1-arbeitstag.title: The working day
de-a1-arbeitstag.summary: Teaches you to say when work starts and finishes and to talk about breaks.

de-a1-feierabend.title: After work
de-a1-feierabend.summary: Teaches you to say what you do after work and what you prefer.

de-a1-wochenende-plan.title: Weekend plans
de-a1-wochenende-plan.summary: Teaches you to describe weekend plans and to talk about plans that are not fixed.

de-a1-zeit-haben.title: Asking if someone has time
de-a1-zeit-haben.summary: Teaches you to ask whether someone has time and to say no politely.

de-a1-kleidung.title: Buying clothes
de-a1-kleidung.summary: Teaches you to say what you are looking for, state your choice and ask where the till is.

de-a1-groesse.title: Size and trying on
de-a1-groesse.summary: Teaches you to ask about size, ask to try something on and say whether it fits.

de-a1-farben.title: Colours
de-a1-farben.summary: Teaches you to name colours and ask for the same item in another colour.

de-a1-preis.title: Asking the price
de-a1-preis.summary: Teaches you to ask the price, say that something is expensive or good value, and understand a discount.

de-a1-gefallen.title: Liking something
de-a1-gefallen.summary: Teaches you to say that you like something, choose between two and ask the other person's opinion.

de-a1-umtausch.title: Exchanges and returns
de-a1-umtausch.summary: Teaches you to exchange something, give the reason and answer the question about the receipt.

de-a1-geschenk.title: Choosing a present
de-a1-geschenk.summary: Teaches you to say who a present is for, make a suggestion and ask for gift wrapping.

de-a1-markt.title: At the market
de-a1-markt.summary: Teaches you to ask the price of several things, adjust the quantity and understand the total.

de-a1-apotheke-kauf.title: Toiletries shopping
de-a1-apotheke-kauf.summary: Teaches you to name toiletries, say what you need and ask which aisle they are in.

de-a1-online.title: Ordering online
de-a1-online.summary: Teaches you to order online, add an item to the basket and talk about delivery times.

de-a1-weg.title: Asking the way
de-a1-weg.summary: Teaches you to ask the way politely and understand the directions you are given.

de-a1-bus-bahn.title: Public transport
de-a1-bus-bahn.summary: Teaches you to say which transport you take and ask where the stop is.

de-a1-ticket.title: Buying a ticket
de-a1-ticket.summary: Teaches you to buy a ticket at the counter, ask about return fares and find the platform.

de-a1-verspaetung.title: Delays
de-a1-verspaetung.summary: Teaches you to understand a delay, ask how long it will take and talk about waiting.

de-a1-taxi.title: In the taxi
de-a1-taxi.summary: Teaches you to give the driver the address, ask how long it takes and talk while paying.

de-a1-stadtplan.title: Distance and location
de-a1-stadtplan.summary: Teaches you to ask whether a place is far and to describe where it is.

de-a1-sehenswuerdig.title: Places to see
de-a1-sehenswuerdig.summary: Teaches you to ask what there is to see in a town and to make suggestions.

de-a1-verlaufen.title: Getting lost
de-a1-verlaufen.summary: Teaches you to say that you are lost and to follow detailed directions.

de-a1-fahrrad.title: By bike
de-a1-fahrrad.summary: Teaches you to talk about cycling, hire a bike and understand warnings.

de-a1-bahnhof-info.title: At the information desk
de-a1-bahnhof-info.summary: Teaches you to ask about departure times, platforms and connections at an information desk.

de-a1-wohnung-zeigen.title: Showing your home
de-a1-wohnung-zeigen.summary: Teaches you to show someone round your home: how many rooms it has and what it is like.

de-a1-zimmer.title: Rooms
de-a1-zimmer.summary: Teaches you the rooms of a home and the article that goes with each one.

de-a1-moebel.title: Where things are
de-a1-moebel.summary: Teaches you to say where things are and to tell the position verbs apart.

de-a1-nachbarn.title: Neighbours
de-a1-nachbarn.summary: Teaches you to meet new neighbours and to knock on the door.

de-a1-hausordnung.title: House rules
de-a1-hausordnung.summary: Teaches you to understand house rules and to say what is not allowed.

de-a1-miete-zahlen.title: Rent and bills
de-a1-miete-zahlen.summary: Teaches you to talk about rent and service charges, and shows the warm and cold rent.

de-a1-putzen.title: Housework
de-a1-putzen.summary: Teaches you to talk about housework and puts separable verbs to work on it.

de-a1-umzug.title: Moving house
de-a1-umzug.summary: Teaches you to ask for help and to talk about moving day.

de-a1-garten.title: Balcony and garden
de-a1-garten.summary: Teaches you to describe what is on the balcony and in the garden.

de-a1-kaputt.title: Reporting a fault
de-a1-kaputt.summary: Teaches you to report something broken at home and to ask for it to be repaired.

de-a1-hobbys.title: Hobbies
de-a1-hobbys.summary: Teaches you to say what you do in your free time and what you enjoy.

de-a1-koennen.title: Abilities
de-a1-koennen.summary: Teaches you to say what you can and cannot do and to ask the other person.

de-a1-sport.title: Sport
de-a1-sport.summary: Teaches you to say whether you do sport and how often.

de-a1-musik.title: Music
de-a1-musik.summary: Teaches you to say what music you listen to and which you prefer.

de-a1-kino.title: An invitation to the cinema
de-a1-kino.summary: Teaches you to invite someone to the cinema, accept an invitation and agree a time.

de-a1-wetter-smalltalk.title: Small talk about the weather
de-a1-wetter-smalltalk.summary: Teaches you to describe the weather and to start small talk with it.

de-a1-park.title: In the park
de-a1-park.summary: Teaches you to describe what there is in a park and to make plans together.

de-a1-schwimmbad.title: At the pool
de-a1-schwimmbad.summary: Teaches you to ask the entrance fee, find the changing rooms and say what you can do.

de-a1-fernsehen.title: TV and series
de-a1-fernsehen.summary: Teaches you to say what you watch, ask about the channel and give the time of a programme.

de-a1-absage.title: Declining politely
de-a1-absage.summary: Teaches you to turn down an invitation without offending and to suggest another day.

de-a1-koerper.title: Parts of the body
de-a1-koerper.summary: Teaches you to name parts of the body and that each one has to be learnt with its article.

de-a1-weh-tun.title: Describing pain
de-a1-weh-tun.summary: Teaches you two ways to say what hurts and to say how long it has been going on.

de-a1-termin-arzt.title: A doctor's appointment
de-a1-termin-arzt.summary: Teaches you to make an appointment on the phone and that day and time take different prepositions.

de-a1-muessen.title: Obligation
de-a1-muessen.summary: Teaches you to express obligation and why the main verb goes to the end of the sentence.

de-a1-apotheke.title: At the pharmacy
de-a1-apotheke.summary: Teaches you to buy medicine at the pharmacy and to understand the polite imperative.

de-a1-krank-melden.title: Calling in sick
de-a1-krank-melden.summary: Teaches you to call in sick and which verb to use when you are ill.

de-a1-imperativ-du.title: Advice to a friend
de-a1-imperativ-du.summary: Teaches you the informal imperative you use when giving a friend advice.

de-a1-notruf.title: An emergency
de-a1-notruf.summary: Teaches you to call for help in an emergency and to give the essential facts on the phone.

de-a1-gesund-leben.title: Healthy living
de-a1-gesund-leben.summary: Teaches you to state health rules that apply to everyone, using the subject 'man'.

de-a1-beim-zahnarzt.title: At the dentist
de-a1-beim-zahnarzt.summary: Teaches you to describe toothache and to understand the dentist's short instructions.

de-a1-telefonieren.title: On the phone
de-a1-telefonieren.summary: Teaches you to introduce yourself on the phone and to ask for someone.

de-a1-nachricht.title: Writing a message
de-a1-nachricht.summary: Teaches you to write a short message and to close it properly.

de-a1-termin-machen.title: Making an appointment
de-a1-termin-machen.summary: Teaches you to make an appointment, propose a date and postpone it.

de-a1-einladung.title: Inviting someone
de-a1-einladung.summary: Teaches you to invite someone and to say what to bring.

de-a1-perfekt-haben.title: The past with haben
de-a1-perfekt-haben.summary: Teaches you to say what you did in the past and shows how the sentence splits in two.

de-a1-perfekt-sein.title: The past with sein
de-a1-perfekt-sein.summary: Teaches you that verbs of movement take a different auxiliary in the past.

de-a1-gestern.title: Talking about yesterday
de-a1-gestern.summary: Teaches you to describe yesterday from start to finish, using both auxiliaries together.

de-a1-wochenende-bericht.title: A weekend report
de-a1-wochenende-bericht.summary: Teaches you to describe your weekend and to say how it went.

de-a1-jahreszeiten.title: Seasons and dates
de-a1-jahreszeiten.summary: Teaches you to name the seasons and to give a date.

de-a1-a1-rueckblick.title: Closing A1
de-a1-a1-rueckblick.summary: Teaches you to say what you have learnt and what comes next.

de-a2-urlaub.title: Your last holiday
de-a2-urlaub.summary: Teaches you to talk about the past, telling the two perfect auxiliaries apart.

de-a2-perfekt-unregel.title: Irregular past participles
de-a2-perfekt-unregel.summary: Teaches you the irregular participles of common verbs and why they have to be learnt by heart.

de-a2-perfekt-trennbar.title: The perfect of separable verbs
de-a2-perfekt-trennbar.summary: Teaches you the participle of separable verbs: the syllable that slips in between prefix and stem.

de-a2-gestern-abend.title: Last night
de-a2-gestern-abend.summary: Teaches you to tell an evening in order: first, then, and last of all.

de-a2-montagmorgen.title: Telling a mishap
de-a2-montagmorgen.summary: Teaches you to describe a morning that went wrong: the delay, the missed train, the mishap.

de-a2-kindheit-foto.title: An old photo
de-a2-kindheit-foto.summary: Teaches you to talk about your childhood, using the past of 'to be' and 'to have'.

de-a2-fruher.title: Then and now
de-a2-fruher.summary: Teaches you to compare the past with today: there was, there wasn't, it was different.

de-a2-erste-mal.title: First times
de-a2-erste-mal.summary: Teaches you to describe something you did for the first time and how it felt.

de-a2-wochenbericht.title: Summing up the week
de-a2-wochenbericht.summary: Teaches you to sum up the past week: what you got done and what happened.

de-a2-tolle-nachricht.title: Sharing news
de-a2-tolle-nachricht.summary: Teaches you to share good news and to surprise the person you are talking to.

de-a2-lebensweg.title: A migration story
de-a2-lebensweg.summary: Teaches you to tell a life story in order: how old you were and what happened next.

de-a2-wollte-konnte.title: Childhood dreams
de-a2-wollte-konnte.summary: Teaches you to talk about a past wish, about what you could not do and what you had to do.

de-a2-schulzeit.title: School years
de-a2-schulzeit.summary: Teaches you to say what was compulsory and what was forbidden at school, in the past tense.

de-a2-umzug-geschichte.title: The story of a move
de-a2-umzug-geschichte.summary: Teaches you to tell the story of a move from start to finish and to say how hard it was at first.

de-a2-kennenlernen.title: How you met
de-a2-kennenlernen.summary: Teaches you to tell the story of meeting someone and of a relationship, using reflexive verbs.

de-a2-drei-jahre.title: Duration and point in time
de-a2-drei-jahre.summary: Teaches you to tell a stretch of time that is still running from a point left in the past.

de-a2-veraenderung.title: Changes
de-a2-veraenderung.summary: Teaches you to say what has changed and what you have got used to.

de-a2-grosseltern.title: Grandparents' memories
de-a2-grosseltern.summary: Teaches you to tell childhood memories: what it was like there, what there was, what was allowed.

de-a2-peinlich.title: An embarrassing moment
de-a2-peinlich.summary: Teaches you to tell an embarrassing thing that happened to you.

de-a2-erfolg.title: A proud moment
de-a2-erfolg.summary: Teaches you to talk about something you achieved and the work behind it.

de-a2-arzt.title: At the doctor's
de-a2-arzt.summary: Teaches you to take and give advice, with three patterns built on the modal 'sollen'.

de-a2-symptome.title: Symptoms
de-a2-symptome.summary: Teaches you to say how you feel and introduces the little pronoun that reflexive verbs carry.

de-a2-duerfen.title: Permission and prohibition
de-a2-duerfen.summary: Teaches you to ask permission, understand a ban and tell three modal verbs apart.

de-a2-hausmittel.title: Home remedies
de-a2-hausmittel.summary: Teaches you to give gentle advice and to talk about home remedies.

de-a2-apotheke-beratung.title: Asking at the pharmacy
de-a2-apotheke-beratung.summary: Teaches you to ask about the dose, the side effects and whether a prescription is needed.

de-a2-sport-verletzung.title: An injury
de-a2-sport-verletzung.summary: Teaches you to describe an injury and the pattern German uses to say what you hurt.

de-a2-krankenkasse.title: Health insurance
de-a2-krankenkasse.summary: Teaches you to understand and answer the insurance questions asked at a practice reception.

de-a2-zahnarzt-termin.title: A dental emergency
de-a2-zahnarzt-termin.summary: Teaches you to describe an urgent toothache on the phone and to confirm the instructions given.

de-a2-stress.title: Stress and sleep
de-a2-stress.summary: Teaches you to talk about stress and where the reflexive pronoun sits in a negative sentence.

de-a2-vorsorge.title: The check-up
de-a2-vorsorge.summary: Teaches you to discuss regular health checks and to phrase advice that holds for everyone.

de-a2-dativ-geben.title: The dative object
de-a2-dativ-geben.summary: Teaches you to name the person correctly when you give something to someone.

de-a2-wem-gehoert.title: Belonging
de-a2-wem-gehoert.summary: Teaches you to ask who something belongs to and to answer.

de-a2-wechsel-wo.title: Where: the dative
de-a2-wechsel-wo.summary: Teaches you to say where something stands and to pick the right verb.

de-a2-wechsel-wohin.title: Where to: the accusative
de-a2-wechsel-wohin.summary: Teaches you to pick the right form and verb when you put something somewhere.

de-a2-einrichten.title: Arranging a room
de-a2-einrichten.summary: Teaches you to furnish a room together and to argue about where things go.

de-a2-nachbarschaft.title: The neighbourhood
de-a2-nachbarschaft.summary: Teaches you to describe what is where in your neighbourhood.

de-a2-leihen.title: Borrowing and helping
de-a2-leihen.summary: Teaches you to ask a neighbour for help and for things, and to thank them.

de-a2-paket.title: Taking in a parcel
de-a2-paket.summary: Teaches you to accept a parcel for a neighbour and to hand it over.

de-a2-laerm.title: A noise complaint
de-a2-laerm.summary: Teaches you to raise the noise from upstairs politely and to soften the complaint.

de-a2-hausmeister.title: The property manager
de-a2-hausmeister.summary: Teaches you to describe a fault at home and to arrange an appointment for the repair.

de-a2-neue-stelle.title: A new job
de-a2-neue-stelle.summary: Teaches you to talk about looking for work and starting a new job.

de-a2-weil.title: Reasons with weil
de-a2-weil.summary: Teaches you the subordinate clause of reason and why the verb moves to the end.

de-a2-denn.title: Reasons with denn
de-a2-denn.summary: Teaches you the conjunction of reason that leaves the verb in place, and how it differs from the other.

de-a2-kollegen.title: Colleagues
de-a2-kollegen.summary: Teaches you to introduce yourself and someone else at work.

de-a2-meeting.title: A meeting
de-a2-meeting.summary: Teaches you to give an opinion in a meeting and to build a subordinate clause with 'dass'.

de-a2-telefon-arbeit.title: Phone calls at work
de-a2-telefon-arbeit.summary: Teaches you to answer the phone at work, take a note and pass a message on.

de-a2-pause.title: The lunch break
de-a2-pause.summary: Teaches you to state a preference at lunch and to choose a dish.

de-a2-urlaub-antrag.title: Asking for leave
de-a2-urlaub-antrag.summary: Teaches you to make a request for leave in writing and in person.

de-a2-krankmeldung-buero.title: The sick note
de-a2-krankmeldung-buero.summary: Teaches you to report an illness to work and to send the sick note by email.

de-a2-feedback.title: Feedback
de-a2-feedback.summary: Teaches you to understand and respond to feedback in an appraisal.

de-a2-komparativ.title: The comparative
de-a2-komparativ.summary: Teaches you to compare two things and the ending the adjective takes.

de-a2-superlativ.title: The superlative
de-a2-superlativ.summary: Teaches you to pick the best of them all and to talk about discounts.

de-a2-zwei-jacken.title: Comparing two products
de-a2-zwei-jacken.summary: Teaches you to state a preference while trying clothes on and to decide between two options.

de-a2-adjektiv-ein.title: Adjective endings
de-a2-adjektiv-ein.summary: Teaches you the first step of adjective declension, with colours and patterns.

de-a2-friseur.title: At the hairdresser's
de-a2-friseur.summary: Teaches you to say what you want at the hairdresser's and to judge the result.

de-a2-reklamation.title: A faulty product
de-a2-reklamation.summary: Teaches you to complain about a faulty product and to ask for a refund.

de-a2-handyvertrag.title: A phone contract
de-a2-handyvertrag.summary: Teaches you to compare tariffs and to ask about the terms of a contract.

de-a2-bank-konto.title: A bank account
de-a2-bank-konto.summary: Teaches you to open an account at the bank and to talk about money matters.

de-a2-post.title: At the post office
de-a2-post.summary: Teaches you to choose how to send something and to talk about the weight.

de-a2-flohmarkt.title: Haggling at the flea market
de-a2-flohmarkt.summary: Teaches you to haggle over second-hand things and to ask what condition they are in.

de-a2-reiseplan.title: Planning a route
de-a2-reiseplan.summary: Teaches you to plan a journey and to describe the route.

de-a2-hotel.title: At the hotel
de-a2-hotel.summary: Teaches you to check in at a hotel and to ask about the room.

de-a2-koffer.title: Packing a suitcase
de-a2-koffer.summary: Teaches you to say what went into the suitcase and what was forgotten.

de-a2-flughafen.title: At the airport
de-a2-flughafen.summary: Teaches you to describe the steps at the airport and what you have to do.

de-a2-wetterbericht.title: The weather forecast
de-a2-wetterbericht.summary: Teaches you to describe the weather and to make a forecast in the future tense.

de-a2-ausflug.title: A day trip
de-a2-ausflug.summary: Teaches you to plan a day trip and to make it depend on a condition.

de-a2-camping.title: At the campsite
de-a2-camping.summary: Teaches you to ask what a campsite has and what it does not.

de-a2-stadtfuehrung.title: A city tour
de-a2-stadtfuehrung.summary: Teaches you to describe the places on a city tour and their history.

de-a2-souvenirs.title: Souvenirs
de-a2-souvenirs.summary: Teaches you to discuss who gets what and to choose a souvenir.

de-a2-reise-problem.title: Travel trouble
de-a2-reise-problem.summary: Teaches you to describe something going wrong on a journey and to find another way.

de-a2-geburtstag.title: A birthday
de-a2-geburtstag.summary: Teaches you to celebrate a birthday and to give the date.

de-a2-party-planen.title: Planning a party
de-a2-party-planen.summary: Teaches you to plan a celebration together and to share out the jobs.

de-a2-gastgeschenk.title: A gift for the host
de-a2-gastgeschenk.summary: Teaches you to discuss what to bring to an invitation and who to give it to.

de-a2-hochzeit.title: At a wedding
de-a2-hochzeit.summary: Teaches you to say who is who at a wedding and to offer congratulations.

de-a2-feiertage.title: German holidays
de-a2-feiertage.summary: Teaches you to describe the celebrations in Germany and to compare them.

de-a2-einladung-absagen.title: Turning down an invitation
de-a2-einladung-absagen.summary: Teaches you to decline an invitation politely and to suggest another date.

de-a2-komplimente.title: Paying a compliment
de-a2-komplimente.summary: Teaches you to pay a compliment, to reply to one and to get the pronoun case right.

de-a2-streit.title: Apologies and making up
de-a2-streit.summary: Teaches you to describe an argument, to apologise and to make up.

de-a2-fernbeziehung.title: Missing family
de-a2-fernbeziehung.summary: Teaches you to talk about keeping in touch with family far away and about missing them.

de-a2-neujahr.title: New year's resolutions
de-a2-neujahr.summary: Teaches you to talk about new year's resolutions and realistic goals.

de-a2-wenn.title: Conditions with wenn
de-a2-wenn.summary: Teaches you the conditional clause and how to describe a habit with it.

de-a2-serien.title: Series
de-a2-serien.summary: Teaches you to recommend a series or a programme and to say what you liked.

de-a2-nachrichten.title: The news
de-a2-nachrichten.summary: Teaches you to pass a news story on and to question whether it is true.

de-a2-social-media.title: Screen time
de-a2-social-media.summary: Teaches you to describe your social media habits and to tie them to a condition.

de-a2-warten-auf.title: Verbs with prepositions
de-a2-warten-auf.summary: Teaches you the verbs that call for a particular preposition, and how to talk about waiting.

de-a2-computerproblem.title: A computer problem
de-a2-computerproblem.summary: Teaches you to describe a computer problem and to give instructions step by step.

de-a2-fotos-teilen.title: Sharing photos
de-a2-fotos-teilen.summary: Teaches you to show photos and to pick the one everyone likes best.

de-a2-podcast.title: Recommending a podcast
de-a2-podcast.summary: Teaches you to describe your interests and the reflexive verb that takes a preposition.

de-a2-online-termin.title: A video call
de-a2-online-termin.summary: Teaches you the technical trouble on a video call and the formal language it is held in.

de-a2-digital-detox.title: A digital break
de-a2-digital-detox.summary: Teaches you to describe a day without a phone and to say how the experience was.

de-a2-buergeramt.title: The registration office
de-a2-buergeramt.summary: Teaches you to register your address and to answer the official's questions.

de-a2-formulare.title: The language of forms
de-a2-formulare.summary: Teaches you to understand the instructions you meet while filling in a form.

de-a2-verspaetet-amt.title: Appointment trouble
de-a2-verspaetet-amt.summary: Teaches you to describe the wait at an office and the language of a written complaint.

de-a2-bibliothek.title: Joining the library
de-a2-bibliothek.summary: Teaches you to understand the library rules and to look for a book.

de-a2-volkshochschule.title: Enrolling on a course
de-a2-volkshochschule.summary: Teaches you to enrol on a course and to make plans in the future tense.

de-a2-zukunftsplaene.title: Plans for the future
de-a2-zukunftsplaene.summary: Teaches you to talk about your plans for the future and to put your goals in order.

de-a2-traumjob.title: Your dream job
de-a2-traumjob.summary: Teaches you to describe the job you dream of and to give your reasons.

de-a2-deutschland-leben.title: Cultural observations
de-a2-deutschland-leben.summary: Teaches you to compare cultural differences and to describe what you have noticed.

de-a2-pruefung.title: Exam nerves
de-a2-pruefung.summary: Teaches you to describe the nerves before an exam and to talk about your preparation.

de-a2-a2-rueckblick.title: Closing A2
de-a2-a2-rueckblick.summary: Teaches you to sum up the road you have travelled and to look back on a stage.

de-b1-bewerbung.title: A job interview
de-b1-bewerbung.summary: Teaches you to give reasons: the weil clause and seit with the dative.

de-b1-lebenslauf.title: Talking through your CV
de-b1-lebenslauf.summary: Teaches you to describe your career history in the past tense of written German.

de-b1-staerken.title: Strengths and weaknesses
de-b1-staerken.summary: Teaches you to describe yourself with a reservation: this may be so, but that is true.

de-b1-anschreiben.title: Explaining your motivation
de-b1-anschreiben.summary: Teaches you to say why you applied, using clauses of purpose.

de-b1-probearbeit.title: Your first day at work
de-b1-probearbeit.summary: Teaches you to ask for information politely with an indirect question.

de-b1-arbeitszeiten.title: Working hours
de-b1-arbeitszeiten.summary: Teaches you to describe flexible working with conditional clauses.

de-b1-gehalt.title: Talking about salary
de-b1-gehalt.summary: Teaches you to discuss pay in polite forms and shows the grammar of politeness.

de-b1-absage-bewerbung.title: A rejection and a fresh try
de-b1-absage-bewerbung.summary: Teaches you to order two past events: the earlier one finished, the later one built on it.

de-b1-kuendigung.title: Resigning
de-b1-kuendigung.summary: Teaches you to explain your decision to leave a job together with your reasons.

de-b1-networking.title: A careers fair
de-b1-networking.summary: Teaches you to start a work conversation with a stranger and to ask questions politely.

de-b1-wohnung.title: Looking for a flat
de-b1-wohnung.summary: Teaches you polite requests and wishes: Konjunktiv II with würde and könnten.

de-b1-besichtigung.title: Viewing a flat
de-b1-besichtigung.summary: Teaches you to ask the right questions politely while viewing a flat.

de-b1-mietvertrag.title: The tenancy agreement
de-b1-mietvertrag.summary: Teaches you to read the language of a contract and shows how the passive is built.

de-b1-nachbarn-streit.title: A dispute with a neighbour
de-b1-nachbarn-streit.summary: Teaches you to raise a complaint without a row and drills the polite forms.

de-b1-wg.title: Choosing a flatmate
de-b1-wg.summary: Teaches you to say what matters to you in a subordinate clause.

de-b1-reparatur-vermieter.title: Requesting a repair
de-b1-reparatur-vermieter.summary: Teaches you to ask the landlord for a repair and to phrase the request formally.

de-b1-nebenkosten.title: The service charge bill
de-b1-nebenkosten.summary: Teaches you to dispute a service charge bill and shows the past form of the passive.

de-b1-einrichtung-stil.title: Taste in furnishing
de-b1-einrichtung-stil.summary: Teaches you how adjectives are declined in front of the noun.

de-b1-umzugshelfer.title: Organising a move
de-b1-umzugshelfer.summary: Teaches you to organise jobs in time order: before, during and after.

de-b1-untermiete.title: A short-term let
de-b1-untermiete.summary: Teaches you to discuss a temporary rental and drills stating a reservation again.

de-b1-damit.title: Purpose with damit
de-b1-damit.summary: Teaches you to state a purpose with a damit clause when the two subjects differ.

de-b1-um-zu.title: Purpose with um … zu
de-b1-um-zu.summary: Teaches you to state a purpose with the um … zu infinitive when the subject stays the same.

de-b1-obwohl.title: Contrast: obwohl and trotzdem
de-b1-obwohl.summary: Teaches you to describe what runs against expectation, with an obwohl clause and the adverb trotzdem.

de-b1-als-wenn.title: Time: als or wenn?
de-b1-als-wenn.summary: Teaches you to use als for a single event in the past and wenn for repeated events and the future.

de-b1-nachdem.title: Sequence in the past: nachdem
de-b1-nachdem.summary: Teaches you to say what happened first, with nachdem and the past perfect.

de-b1-bevor-waehrend.title: Before and during: bevor, während
de-b1-bevor-waehrend.summary: Teaches you to link events with bevor (before) and während (while).

de-b1-deshalb-trotzdem.title: Result: deshalb, darum, trotzdem
de-b1-deshalb-trotzdem.summary: Teaches you to state a result, or an unexpected one, with main-clause adverbs and verb-second order.

de-b1-je-desto.title: Proportion: je … desto
de-b1-je-desto.summary: Teaches you to say that two things rise together, with je … desto.

de-b1-entweder-oder.title: Pairs: entweder…oder, sowohl…als auch, weder…noch
de-b1-entweder-oder.summary: Teaches you to offer alternatives, to say both and to say neither, with paired conjunctions.

de-b1-geschichte.title: A story built on connectors
de-b1-geschichte.summary: Teaches you to combine the module's connectors in one story: zuerst, nachdem, während, deshalb, am Ende.

de-b1-relativ-nom.title: Relative clauses: nominative
de-b1-relativ-nom.summary: Teaches you to define a person by what they do: der, die, das.

de-b1-relativ-akk.title: Relative clauses: accusative
de-b1-relativ-akk.summary: Teaches you that der becomes den when the thing defined is the object of the clause.

de-b1-relativ-dativ.title: Relative clauses: dative
de-b1-relativ-dativ.summary: Teaches you that the relative pronoun is dem, der or denen after verbs that take the dative.

de-b1-relativ-praep.title: Relative clauses with a preposition
de-b1-relativ-praep.summary: Teaches you that when a preposition comes first, it is the preposition that sets the case.

de-b1-traumhaus.title: Describing your dream home
de-b1-traumhaus.summary: Teaches you to describe what you dream of, with relative clauses that take their preposition from the verb.

de-b1-menschen-beschreiben.title: Describing people
de-b1-menschen-beschreiben.summary: Teaches you to build relative clauses with jemand, niemand and plural nouns.

de-b1-gegenstand.title: Describing an object
de-b1-gegenstand.summary: Teaches you to describe an object whose name you do not know, and to use was after alles and etwas.

de-b1-lieblingsort.title: Describing a favourite place
de-b1-lieblingsort.summary: Teaches you the difference between an dem, in dem and wo when you describe a place.

de-b1-fundbuero.title: Describing a lost item
de-b1-fundbuero.summary: Teaches you to describe a lost item to an official, using relative clauses.

de-b1-rezept-empfehlen.title: Recommending a recipe
de-b1-rezept-empfehlen.summary: Teaches you to recommend a dish and its ingredients with relative clauses.

de-b1-passiv.title: The passive: present
de-b1-passiv.summary: Teaches you to build a passive sentence with werden when who does it does not matter.

de-b1-passiv-vergangen.title: The passive: past
de-b1-passiv-vergangen.summary: Teaches you to build the past passive with wurde and to tell the form worden apart.

de-b1-auslaenderbehoerde.title: Residence formalities
de-b1-auslaenderbehoerde.summary: Teaches you to understand the formal passive of residence procedures and to ask about them.

de-b1-widerspruch.title: A letter of appeal
de-b1-widerspruch.summary: Teaches you to appeal against an official decision in writing and to phrase the request with dass.

de-b1-fuehrerschein.title: Getting a driving licence
de-b1-fuehrerschein.summary: Teaches you to describe an official process in order, with passive and conditional clauses.

de-b1-steuer.title: The tax return
de-b1-steuer.summary: Teaches you to use the passive and the active each in its place while describing a tax return.

de-b1-versicherung.title: An insurance claim
de-b1-versicherung.summary: Teaches you to report damage in order and to say what happened first with the past perfect.

de-b1-termin-verschieben.title: Postponing an appointment
de-b1-termin-verschieben.summary: Teaches you the most polite request patterns for postponing an official appointment.

de-b1-vollmacht.title: Power of attorney
de-b1-vollmacht.summary: Teaches you the language of the document that authorises someone to act on your behalf.

de-b1-einbuergerung.title: Talking about citizenship
de-b1-einbuergerung.summary: Teaches you to ask about official details you do not know, with indirect question patterns.

de-b1-infinitiv-zu.title: The zu infinitive
de-b1-infinitiv-zu.summary: Teaches you to state an intention with zu plus the infinitive, and where zu goes in a separable verb.

de-b1-lernziele.title: Learning goals
de-b1-lernziele.summary: Teaches you to define a goal you can measure and to break it into steps.

de-b1-sprachkurs.title: Choosing a course
de-b1-sprachkurs.summary: Teaches you to choose between two courses by comparing them and to justify your choice.

de-b1-pruefung-b1.title: Exam strategy
de-b1-pruefung-b1.summary: Teaches you to talk about exam nerves with conditional clauses and to describe a strategy.

de-b1-weiterbildung.title: Professional development
de-b1-weiterbildung.summary: Teaches you to justify the aim of a training course with um … zu and to say what it is good for.

de-b1-studium.title: University
de-b1-studium.summary: Teaches you to ask what you do not know about a university application, with indirect questions.

de-b1-praktikum.title: An internship
de-b1-praktikum.summary: Teaches you to describe an experience in the past tense that written German uses.

de-b1-lernmethoden.title: Study techniques
de-b1-lernmethoden.summary: Teaches you to describe your methods with paired conjunctions and to say which works best.

de-b1-fehlerkultur.title: Making peace with mistakes
de-b1-fehlerkultur.summary: Teaches you to talk about making mistakes with clauses of contrast, and to keep your nerve.

de-b1-mentor.title: A mentoring session
de-b1-mentor.summary: Teaches you to give and to ask for advice in the subjunctive.

de-b1-meinung.title: Giving an opinion
de-b1-meinung.summary: Teaches you to state your own opinion and to say whether you share someone else's.

de-b1-pro-contra.title: Weighing pros and cons
de-b1-pro-contra.summary: Teaches you to weigh both sides of a question with paired conjunctions and to reach a conclusion.

de-b1-diskussion-hoeflich.title: Objecting politely
de-b1-diskussion-hoeflich.summary: Teaches you the soft patterns of objection that disagree without damaging the relationship.

de-b1-medienkonsum.title: The screen time argument
de-b1-medienkonsum.summary: Teaches you to give an opinion with verbs that take a fixed preposition and to answer conditionally.

de-b1-fake-news.title: Questioning a source
de-b1-fake-news.summary: Teaches you to doubt a claim and to dig into its source with an indirect question.

de-b1-serienabend.title: Reviewing a series
de-b1-serienabend.summary: Teaches you to judge a production with clauses of contrast and to describe your expectations.

de-b2-weltraum.title: Climate and nature
de-b2-weltraum.summary: Teaches you to describe nature under threat with participial adjectives.

de-b2-medizin-fortschritt.title: Advances in medicine
de-b2-medizin-fortschritt.summary: Teaches you to report medical advances with the past passive.

de-b2-technikfrust.title: When technology fails
de-b2-technikfrust.summary: Teaches you to describe a fault and to explain the fix with a clause of means.

de-b2-zukunftstechnologien.title: Technologies to come
de-b2-zukunftstechnologien.summary: Teaches you to state predictions about the future by how sure you are.

de-b2-wegen-trotz.title: Genitive prepositions
de-b2-wegen-trotz.summary: Teaches you to state cause and contrast with the prepositions that take the genitive.

de-b2-aufgrund-infolge.title: Official language of cause
de-b2-aufgrund-infolge.summary: Teaches you to use the prepositions of cause in the language of official notices.

de-b2-inflation.title: Talking about inflation
de-b2-inflation.summary: Teaches you to describe rising prices in nominal economic language.

de-b2-wohnungsmarkt.title: The housing market
de-b2-wohnungsmarkt.summary: Teaches you to describe supply and demand with the conjunction of proportion.

de-b2-arbeitsmarkt.title: The labour market
de-b2-arbeitsmarkt.summary: Teaches you to describe a shortage of staff with the stand-ins for the passive.

de-b2-ehrenamt-b2.title: Civil society
de-b2-ehrenamt-b2.summary: Teaches you to say what volunteering does, with a clause of means.

de-b2-generationen.title: Talking across generations
de-b2-generationen.summary: Teaches you to discuss the generations with two-part conjunctions that name both sides.

de-b2-landflucht.title: Country or city?
de-b2-landflucht.summary: Teaches you to explain the trend of migration with the conjunction of proportion.

de-b2-steuern-b2.title: The tax debate
de-b2-steuern-b2.summary: Teaches you to describe and to debate public spending in the passive.

de-b2-wahl.title: Talking about elections
de-b2-wahl.summary: Teaches you to discuss election forecasts and promises together with their source.

de-b2-roman.title: Talking about literature
de-b2-roman.summary: Teaches you to introduce a book with relative clauses after a preposition.

de-b2-dessen-deren.title: Relative clauses: genitive
de-b2-dessen-deren.summary: Teaches you to join two sentences into one with dessen and deren.

de-b2-theater.title: Reviewing a production
de-b2-theater.summary: Teaches you to judge a staging with participial adjectives.

de-b2-museum-fuehrung.title: Guiding at a museum
de-b2-museum-fuehrung.summary: Teaches you to introduce the exhibits in the past passive.

de-b2-musik-analyse.title: Analysing music
de-b2-musik-analyse.summary: Teaches you to say how music has its effect, with a clause of means.

de-b2-fotografie.title: The turning point of a match
de-b2-fotografie.summary: Teaches you to describe a match and its result with participial adjectives.

de-b2-architektur.title: Talking about architecture
de-b2-architektur.summary: Teaches you to describe buildings with relative clauses of possession.

de-b2-festival.title: A festival experience
de-b2-festival.summary: Teaches you to describe the experience of an event in nominal phrases.

de-b2-kabarett.title: Second-hand advice
de-b2-kabarett.summary: Teaches you to pass on travel tips you have heard, with subjective modals.

de-b2-kunstmarkt.title: The art market
de-b2-kunstmarkt.summary: Teaches you to discuss the link between value and price with the conjunction of proportion.

de-b2-gehaltsverhandlung.title: A salary negotiation
de-b2-gehaltsverhandlung.summary: Teaches you to put a pay claim in the subjunctive, together with your reasons.

de-b2-sparen-anlegen.title: Talking about savings
de-b2-sparen-anlegen.summary: Teaches you to discuss risk against return with the conjunction of proportion.

de-b2-selbststaendig.title: Entrepreneurship
de-b2-selbststaendig.summary: Teaches you to set out a business plan with conditional conjunctions.

de-b2-buerokratie-gruendung.title: Setting up a company
de-b2-buerokratie-gruendung.summary: Teaches you to discuss official formalities in nominal, formal language.

de-b2-work-life.title: Work-life balance
de-b2-work-life.summary: Teaches you to draw a line and to describe balance with clauses of purpose.

de-b2-networking-b2.title: Building a network
de-b2-networking-b2.summary: Teaches you to talk about making contacts, with the stand-ins for the passive.

de-b2-jobwechsel.title: Changing jobs
de-b2-jobwechsel.summary: Teaches you to describe a risky decision with a conjunction of contrast.

de-b2-rente.title: Retirement
de-b2-rente.summary: Teaches you to talk about an uncertain future with subjective modals.

de-b2-nebenjob.title: A second job
de-b2-nebenjob.summary: Teaches you to discuss the terms of a second job with genitive prepositions.

de-b2-teures-hobby.title: Expensive hobbies
de-b2-teures-hobby.summary: Teaches you to defend a costly pursuit with relative clauses of possession.

de-b2-als-ob.title: Unreal comparisons
de-b2-als-ob.summary: Teaches you to build comparisons that are not real, with als ob.

de-b2-vermutungen.title: Degrees of likelihood
de-b2-vermutungen.summary: Teaches you to tell degrees of certainty apart with dürfte, müsste and könnte.

de-b2-koerpersprache.title: Body language
de-b2-koerpersprache.summary: Teaches you to say how body language has its effect, with a clause of means.

de-b2-missverstaendnis.title: A misunderstanding
de-b2-missverstaendnis.summary: Teaches you to name a misunderstanding with als ob and to put it right.

de-b2-motivation-psy.title: Motivation
de-b2-motivation-psy.summary: Teaches you to discuss putting things off and pushing past it, with the stand-ins for the passive.

de-b2-gewohnheiten.title: Habits
de-b2-gewohnheiten.summary: Teaches you to describe how a habit is built and how it is broken.

de-b2-empathie.title: Empathy
de-b2-empathie.summary: Teaches you to describe putting yourself in someone else's place, in the subjunctive.

de-b2-streitkultur.title: The culture of debate
de-b2-streitkultur.summary: Teaches you to set out the rules of a fair debate with two-part conjunctions.

de-b2-perfektionismus.title: Perfectionism
de-b2-perfektionismus.summary: Teaches you to name the unreal standards you set yourself, with als ob.

de-b2-veraenderung-b2.title: The courage to change
de-b2-veraenderung-b2.summary: Teaches you to talk about change with conditional conjunctions and the language of courage.

de-b2-formeller-brief.title: A formal letter
de-b2-formeller-brief.summary: Teaches you the fixed patterns and the skeleton of formal writing.

de-b2-anfrage.title: A request for information
de-b2-anfrage.summary: Teaches you to put a request for information politely, in the subjunctive.

de-b2-angebot-vergleichen.title: Comparing quotes
de-b2-angebot-vergleichen.summary: Teaches you to weigh up quotes and to decide with reasons.

de-b2-bewerbungsgespraech-b2.title: Asking questions at interview
de-b2-bewerbungsgespraech-b2.summary: Teaches you to draw information out with indirect questions at the end of an interview.

de-b2-praesentation-abschluss.title: Closing a presentation
de-b2-praesentation-abschluss.summary: Teaches you to close a presentation with a summary, a conclusion and a look ahead.

de-b2-verabschiedung-kollegen.title: A farewell speech
de-b2-verabschiedung-kollegen.summary: Teaches you to build a short farewell speech with the past behind the past.

de-b2-empfehlung-schreiben.title: Writing a reference
de-b2-empfehlung-schreiben.summary: Teaches you the formal, participle-heavy language of a letter of reference.

de-b2-kulturschock-rueckwaerts.title: Reverse culture shock
de-b2-kulturschock-rueckwaerts.summary: Teaches you to describe being caught between two places, with als ob.

de-b2-c1-vorbereitung.title: Getting ready for C1
de-b2-c1-vorbereitung.summary: Teaches you to assess your own level and to make a plan with a target.

de-b2-rueckblick.title: Closing B2
de-b2-rueckblick.summary: Teaches you to sum up the road travelled, with the past passive.

de-c1-fvg-treffen.title: Function verb phrases I
de-c1-fvg-treffen.summary: Teaches you to build the fixed phrases where the verb gives way to a noun, in formal language.

de-c1-fvg-stellen.title: Function verb phrases II
de-c1-fvg-stellen.summary: Teaches you to use the function verb phrases that institutional language leans on most.

de-c1-diplomatisch.title: A diplomatic register
de-c1-diplomatisch.summary: Teaches you to voice an objection without losing the other side.

de-c1-zwischen-zeilen.title: Reading between the lines
de-c1-zwischen-zeilen.summary: Teaches you to sense from the particles the gap between what is said and what is meant.

de-c1-krisenkommunikation.title: Crisis communication
de-c1-krisenkommunikation.summary: Teaches you the distanced, nominal language of a corporate crisis statement.

de-c1-verhandlung-c1.title: Advanced negotiation
de-c1-verhandlung-c1.summary: Teaches you to open a subject, to take on risk and to ask for something in return.

de-c1-fuehrung.title: The language of leadership
de-c1-fuehrung.summary: Teaches you to steer without giving orders, in the language of suggestion and support.

de-c1-buerojargon.title: Office jargon
de-c1-buerojargon.summary: Teaches you to understand the set phrases of office German and to use them when you need to.

de-c1-pitch.title: An investor pitch
de-c1-pitch.summary: Teaches you to build the rhetoric that convinces in a short space of time.

de-c1-konfliktmoderation.title: Mediation
de-c1-konfliktmoderation.summary: Teaches you to report both sides impartially and to look for common ground.

de-c1-doch.title: The colours of doch
de-c1-doch.summary: Teaches you the work the particle doch does: inviting, insisting and pushing back.

de-c1-ja-mal.title: ja and mal
de-c1-ja-mal.summary: Teaches you the particle ja for surprise and the particle mal for softening a request.

de-c1-eben-halt.title: A tone of acceptance
de-c1-eben-halt.summary: Teaches you the tone of accepting what cannot be changed, with eben and halt.

de-c1-wohl.title: A guessing tone
de-c1-wohl.summary: Teaches you to say something without being sure, with the particle wohl.

de-c1-schon.title: A comforting tone
de-c1-schon.summary: Teaches you the soothing, comforting tone the particle schon carries.

de-c1-partikel-streit.title: Tones of impatience
de-c1-partikel-streit.summary: Teaches you to judge the dose of impatience and warning that particles carry.

de-c1-untertreibung.title: German understatement
de-c1-untertreibung.summary: Teaches you the culture of saying little and meaning much, and how to use it.

de-c1-smalltalk-c1.title: Subtle conversation
de-c1-smalltalk-c1.summary: Teaches you to keep a conversation flowing with particles and ready-made phrases.

de-c1-telefonton.title: Tone on the phone
de-c1-telefonton.summary: Teaches you to build the most polite forms of request on the phone.

de-c1-partikel-pruefung.title: Particles in combination
de-c1-partikel-pruefung.summary: Teaches you to use particles together and in the right order.

de-c1-inversion.title: Inversion for emphasis
de-c1-inversion.summary: Teaches you to put a complement first for emphasis while the verb keeps its place.

de-c1-dreierfigur.title: The rule of three
de-c1-dreierfigur.summary: Teaches you to speak memorably with a threefold list and a pause.

de-c1-metapher-vortrag.title: Metaphor in a presentation
de-c1-metapher-vortrag.summary: Teaches you to make an abstract idea concrete with an image.

de-c1-publikum.title: A difficult audience
de-c1-publikum.summary: Teaches you to meet hard questions and heckling calmly.

de-c1-stegreif.title: Speaking off the cuff
de-c1-stegreif.summary: Teaches you to buy time and to give your talk a shape when you speak unprepared.

de-c1-moderation.title: Hosting an event
de-c1-moderation.summary: Teaches you to open an event, to build the links between its parts and to close it.

de-c1-schlagfertig.title: A ready answer
de-c1-schlagfertig.summary: Teaches you to meet a barbed remark calmly and with grace.

de-c1-storytelling.title: Storytelling
de-c1-storytelling.summary: Teaches you to tell an event along an arc of tension.

de-c1-abschlussrede.title: A farewell speech
de-c1-abschlussrede.summary: Teaches you to build a short farewell speech out of images and appreciation.

de-c1-debatte-c1.title: Mastering debate
de-c1-debatte-c1.summary: Teaches you to concede a point and still defend your case, with concessive conjunctions.

de-c1-daumen.title: Idioms of the body
de-c1-daumen.summary: Teaches you idioms built on the body and the trap of translating them word for word.

de-c1-tomaten.title: Idioms of food
de-c1-tomaten.summary: Teaches you what idioms built on food really mean.

de-c1-tiere-idiome.title: Idioms of animals
de-c1-tiere-idiome.summary: Teaches you idioms built on animals and the phrases that express trust.

de-c1-wetter-idiome.title: Weather as metaphor
de-c1-wetter-idiome.summary: Teaches you the metaphors of mood and atmosphere built on images of weather.

de-c1-farben-idiome.title: Idioms of colour
de-c1-farben-idiome.summary: Teaches you idioms built on colours and the traps they carry.

de-c1-sport-idiome.title: Idioms from sport
de-c1-sport-idiome.summary: Teaches you to express persistence and rivalry with idioms that come from sport.

de-c1-geld-idiome.title: Idioms of money
de-c1-geld-idiome.summary: Teaches you idioms about money and the phrases that express certainty.

de-c1-musik-idiome.title: Idioms from music
de-c1-musik-idiome.summary: Teaches you to describe power and influence with idioms that come from music.

de-c1-falsche-freunde-idiome.title: Traps from English
de-c1-falsche-freunde-idiome.summary: Teaches you the trap of translating an idiom word for word, and how to look for the real equivalent.

de-c1-idiome-alltag.title: A day told in idioms
de-c1-idiome-alltag.summary: Teaches you to use idioms in the right dose and in context.

de-c1-konjunktiv1.title: Reported speech in full
de-c1-konjunktiv1.summary: Teaches you every form of the reporting mood and what it is for.

de-c1-pressebericht.title: News agency language
de-c1-pressebericht.summary: Teaches you to attribute a source and to report it in the language of a news agency.

de-c1-wissenschaftssprache.title: Academic register
de-c1-wissenschaftssprache.summary: Teaches you to report a finding in impersonal academic language.

de-c1-quellenkritik.title: Weighing a source
de-c1-quellenkritik.summary: Teaches you to separate a reported claim from a proven fact.

de-c1-abstract.title: Writing an abstract
de-c1-abstract.summary: Teaches you to write the abstract of a study with academic patterns.

de-c1-vortrag-uni.title: Defending a thesis
de-c1-vortrag-uni.summary: Teaches you to accept an objection and still defend your thesis, in academic language.

de-c1-fachdiskussion.title: A discussion between experts
de-c1-fachdiskussion.summary: Teaches you to follow the expert language compressed into extended attributes.

de-c1-populaerwissenschaft.title: Simplifying science
de-c1-populaerwissenschaft.summary: Teaches you to simplify a complex subject without breaking what is true.

de-c1-zitat.title: Quotation and attribution
de-c1-zitat.summary: Teaches you to report a quotation faithfully and where distortion begins.

de-c1-podiumsdiskussion.title: On a panel
de-c1-podiumsdiskussion.summary: Teaches you to take the floor on a panel, to draw distinctions and to keep to time.

de-c1-vertragsklauseln.title: Reading a contract
de-c1-vertragsklauseln.summary: Teaches you to unpack the nominal language of contract clauses.

de-c1-agb.title: Terms and conditions
de-c1-agb.summary: Teaches you the impersonal modal passive of standard terms and conditions.

de-c1-miete-recht.title: A tenant's rights
de-c1-miete-recht.summary: Teaches you to build a claim with the function verb phrases of legal language.

de-c1-arbeitsrecht.title: Talking employment law
de-c1-arbeitsrecht.summary: Teaches you to relay a legal opinion in the reporting mood.

de-c1-datenschutz-c1.title: The language of data protection
de-c1-datenschutz-c1.summary: Teaches you the genitive-heavy language of data protection texts.

de-c1-polizei-aussage.title: Giving a statement
de-c1-polizei-aussage.summary: Teaches you to give a witness statement truthfully and to mark its limits.

de-c1-versicherungsfall.title: An insurance dispute
de-c1-versicherungsfall.summary: Teaches you to defend a contested claim with concessive conjunctions.

de-c1-buergschaft.title: Standing surety
de-c1-buergschaft.summary: Teaches you to discuss in legal language what taking on a guarantee means.

de-c1-einspruch.title: Mastering the formal appeal
de-c1-einspruch.summary: Teaches you to lodge an appeal that protects the deadline and to submit the grounds later.

de-c1-gericht.title: A courtroom scene
de-c1-gericht.summary: Teaches you to follow courtroom language and the reporting of the record.

de-c1-partizipial.title: Extended attributes
de-c1-partizipial.summary: Teaches you to fold a relative clause in front of the noun and to unfold it again.

de-c1-gerundiv.title: The gerundive
de-c1-gerundiv.summary: Teaches you to build the sense of what has to be done, with zu plus the participle.

de-c1-schachtelsatz.title: Unpacking a nested sentence
de-c1-schachtelsatz.summary: Teaches you to find the core of a long sentence and to break it into parts.

de-c1-nominal-verbal.title: Switching register
de-c1-nominal-verbal.summary: Teaches you to move both ways between the nominal style and the verbal style.

de-c1-apposition.title: Appositions
de-c1-apposition.summary: Teaches you to build an aside in the right case and between commas.

de-c1-verweiswoerter.title: The language of reference
de-c1-verweiswoerter.summary: Teaches you to bind a text together with the references inside it.

de-c1-ellipse.title: Elliptical writing
de-c1-ellipse.summary: Teaches you to write short and clear by dropping what is not needed.

de-c1-doppeldeutig.title: Playing on double meaning
de-c1-doppeldeutig.summary: Teaches you to build a deliberate double meaning and to notice one.

de-c1-textsorten.title: Changing text type
de-c1-textsorten.summary: Teaches you to turn the same content into different text types and registers.

de-c1-praezision.title: Precision in word choice
de-c1-praezision.summary: Teaches you to tell apart the meanings of words that lie close together.

de-c1-als-ob-c1.title: Mastering unreal comparison
de-c1-als-ob-c1.summary: Teaches you to build an unreal comparison both with and without a conjunction.

de-c1-konzessiv.title: Concessive conjunctions
de-c1-konzessiv.summary: Teaches you to use the formal concessive conjunctions with the right case and word order.

de-c1-hypothesen.title: The language of hypothesis
de-c1-hypothesen.summary: Teaches you to set up a hypothesis and to argue about what would follow from it.

de-c1-migrationsdebatte.title: The identity debate
de-c1-migrationsdebatte.summary: Teaches you to describe belonging with concessive clauses that cut both ways.

de-c1-klimadebatte.title: The climate debate
de-c1-klimadebatte.summary: Teaches you to separate individual from systemic responsibility in nominal language.

de-c1-bildungsdebatte.title: The education debate
de-c1-bildungsdebatte.summary: Teaches you to argue about a past that never happened, with unreal conditions.

de-c1-ethik-ki.title: The ethics of AI
de-c1-ethik-ki.summary: Teaches you to question what we attribute to machines, with unreal comparison.

de-c1-generationenvertrag.title: The generational contract
de-c1-generationenvertrag.summary: Teaches you to debate the load between generations in concessive and genitive language.

de-c1-meinungsfreiheit.title: Freedom of expression
de-c1-meinungsfreiheit.summary: Teaches you to define the limits with the language of reference that draws distinctions.

de-c1-zukunftsvision.title: A vision of the future
de-c1-zukunftsvision.summary: Teaches you to design a future that has not been built, in the unreal mood.

de-c1-ironie.title: Hearing irony
de-c1-ironie.summary: Teaches you to recognise the sentences where what is said is the opposite of what is meant.

de-c1-sarkasmus-grenze.title: Humour at the limit
de-c1-sarkasmus-grenze.summary: Teaches you to notice where a joke turns into a hurt, and to take it back.

de-c1-wortspiele.title: Wordplay
de-c1-wortspiele.summary: Teaches you to spot wordplay on double meanings and to see the limit of translation.

de-c1-regionale-kultur.title: Regional stereotypes
de-c1-regionale-kultur.summary: Teaches you to talk about regional stereotypes with a wink and without a sweeping judgement.

de-c1-dialekte-hoeren.title: Awareness of dialect
de-c1-dialekte-hoeren.summary: Teaches you a way of listening that aims to understand regional differences.

de-c1-duzen-siezen-c1.title: The art of switching to du
de-c1-duzen-siezen-c1.summary: Teaches you to offer the informal du politely, and to decline it.

de-c1-komplimente-c1.title: A well-judged compliment
de-c1-komplimente-c1.summary: Teaches you to pay a compliment in the right measure and convincingly.

de-c1-peinlichkeiten.title: Recovering from a gaffe
de-c1-peinlichkeiten.summary: Teaches you to rescue the situation with idioms after you have put your foot in it.

de-c1-deutscher-humor.title: Talking about humour
de-c1-deutscher-humor.summary: Teaches you to recognise dry humour and to talk about humour itself.

de-c1-kulturschock-fein.title: Fine cultural differences
de-c1-kulturschock-fein.summary: Teaches you to name a cultural difference without judging it.

de-c1-krisensitzung.title: A crisis meeting
de-c1-krisensitzung.summary: Teaches you the language of fast decisions in a crisis, with function verb phrases.

de-c1-improvisation.title: An improvised fix
de-c1-improvisation.summary: Teaches you to offer a stopgap when the plan breaks and to state its limits honestly.

de-c1-vermittlung.title: Translating across cultures
de-c1-vermittlung.summary: Teaches you to carry across in sense what cannot be carried across word for word.

de-c1-grosse-rede.title: The big speech
de-c1-grosse-rede.summary: Teaches you to bring every rhetorical tool together in a single speech.

de-c1-verhandlungsfinale.title: The final negotiation
de-c1-verhandlungsfinale.summary: Teaches you to close a negotiation in the diplomatic subjunctive.

de-c1-pruefungssimulation.title: A mock exam
de-c1-pruefungssimulation.summary: Teaches you to discuss the exam format and the marking criteria in academic language.

de-c1-mentoring-c1.title: Advice to a new learner
de-c1-mentoring-c1.summary: Teaches you to pass on your own path through learning to someone else.

de-c1-zweisprachig-leben.title: A bilingual identity
de-c1-zweisprachig-leben.summary: Teaches you to describe being bilingual through unreal comparisons.

de-c1-sprachwandel.title: How language changes
de-c1-sprachwandel.summary: Teaches you to discuss language change apart from the rhetoric of decline.

de-c1-finale.title: The C1 finale
de-c1-finale.summary: Teaches you to weigh the road travelled in metaphors, and closes the level.

de-a1-hallo.scene: You have just moved into your block and you meet a neighbour on the stairs. Introduce yourself: say your name, where you are from and where you live.
de-a1-hallo.openingTr: Hello! You're new here, aren't you? What's your name?
de-a1-hallo.goal: Your neighbour has learnt your name, where you are from and which floor you live on, and you have both said you are pleased to meet.

de-a1-wie-gehts.scene: You meet a colleague at the door of your workplace. Ask how they are, say how you are, and be sure to put the question back to them.
de-a1-wie-gehts.openingTr: Good morning! How are you today?
de-a1-wie-gehts.goal: You have both asked and answered how the other is, and made a short remark about how the day will go.

de-a1-du-oder-sie.scene: It is your first day at work and you are meeting your new boss. Use the polite form (Sie) throughout: ask their name, introduce yourself and say where you live.
de-a1-du-oder-sie.openingTr: Good afternoon! Are you new here on the team?
de-a1-du-oder-sie.goal: You have learnt your boss's name and where they live, and they have told you your first task.

de-a1-woher.scene: It is the first day of a German course and you are getting to know the person next to you. Ask where they are from and where they live, and talk about yourself too.
de-a1-woher.partner: a shy but friendly fellow student
de-a1-woher.openingTr: Hello! I'm new here too. Where are you from?
de-a1-woher.goal: You have both learnt where the other is from and where they live, and decided to sit next to each other in the course.

de-a1-sprachen.scene: Someone at the next table in a café has struck up a conversation with you. Ask which languages they speak and talk about your own.
de-a1-sprachen.openingTr: Excuse me, do you speak German?
de-a1-sprachen.goal: You have each learnt which languages the other speaks and decided which language to carry on in.

de-a1-zahlen.scene: You are joining a gym and you are at the reception desk. Give your phone number, then ask how much the monthly fee is.
de-a1-zahlen.partner: a fast-talking but helpful member of staff
de-a1-zahlen.openingTr: Good afternoon! You'd like to become a member? What's your phone number?
de-a1-zahlen.goal: Your phone number has been taken down, and you have been told the monthly fee and when the membership starts.

de-a1-alphabet.scene: You are getting a library card. The assistant will ask for your first name and surname: say them, spell them, and ask how a word is written when you need to.
de-a1-alphabet.openingTr: Good afternoon! I need your first name and your surname. Can you spell that?
de-a1-alphabet.goal: Your first name and surname have been written down letter by letter, and you have been told when the card will be ready.

de-a1-beruf.scene: You are at a party at a neighbour's flat and someone you have just met asks what you do. Say your job, what work it involves and where you work.
de-a1-beruf.openingTr: Good evening! And what do you do for a living?
de-a1-beruf.goal: The other person has learnt your job and where you work, and has told you about their own.

de-a1-alter.scene: You are at a friend's birthday party and you have just met someone new there. Ask how old they are, and say your own age and where you were born.
de-a1-alter.openingTr: Hello, I'm Lena and today I'm thirty. How old are you?
de-a1-alter.goal: You have both given your age and where you were born, and found one small thing you have in common.

de-a1-formular.scene: You are registering your address at the town hall and the clerk is filling in the form for you. Give your name, your address, your postcode and the town you live in.
de-a1-formular.openingTr: Good afternoon! What's your name, please?
de-a1-formular.goal: Every field on the form has been filled in and the clerk has told you the registration is complete.

de-a1-familie.scene: You are at a work dinner and someone at the table has asked you to talk about your family. Introduce your mother, your father and your children, and give their names.
de-a1-familie.partner: a polite table companion who is genuinely interested
de-a1-familie.openingTr: Do tell me about your family. Do you have children?
de-a1-familie.goal: The person at the table has learnt who your family is made up of, and has told you something about their own.

de-a1-geschwister.scene: You are on a coffee break at work and talking about your families with a colleague. Talk about your brothers and sisters, and ask about theirs.
de-a1-geschwister.partner: a chatty colleague from a large family
de-a1-geschwister.openingTr: I have three sisters. And you, do you have any brothers or sisters?
de-a1-geschwister.goal: You have both learnt how many brothers and sisters the other has and who lives where.

de-a1-kein.scene: A friend is inviting you out to eat this evening, but you have neither the time nor the money. Say no politely and explain why.
de-a1-kein.partner: a persistent friend who understands in the end
de-a1-kein.openingTr: We're going out to eat this evening. Are you coming along?
de-a1-kein.goal: The invitation has been turned down politely, the reason has been given and another day has been promised.

de-a1-haustiere.scene: You are sitting on a bench in the park and someone with a dog has sat down beside you. Talk about your own pet, give its name and age, and ask about theirs.
de-a1-haustiere.partner: a talkative park regular who dotes on animals
de-a1-haustiere.openingTr: My dog is called Rocky. Do you have a pet too?
de-a1-haustiere.goal: Both animals' names, ages and characters have been talked about, and you have promised to meet again in the park.

de-a1-fotos.scene: You are showing a friend your family photo album. Say who the people in the photos are and answer your friend's questions.
de-a1-fotos.partner: a curious friend who asks about every single face
de-a1-fotos.openingTr: Lovely photo! Who's that next to you?
de-a1-fotos.goal: Everyone in the photos has been introduced and your friend has worked out who is who.

de-a1-plural.scene: You are at a second-hand book stall and the seller is asking how many books you are taking. Say so with numbers and plural words.
de-a1-plural.partner: a chatty stallholder who enjoys haggling
de-a1-plural.openingTr: Good afternoon! How many books are you taking?
de-a1-plural.goal: How many books you are taking and the total price have been settled, and the purchase is done.

de-a1-aussehen.scene: A friend is talking about someone they have just met and you want to know what they look like. Ask about their height, their hair and whether they wear glasses.
de-a1-aussehen.partner: a friend who loves telling a story and exaggerates a little
de-a1-aussehen.openingTr: I have a new friend, he's very tall. What does your best friend look like?
de-a1-aussehen.goal: The person's height, hair and glasses have been described, well enough for you to pick them out in a crowd.

de-a1-freunde.scene: Someone you have just met is curious about the friend whose name you mention so often. Say where they live, what they do and how often you meet.
de-a1-freunde.partner: a new acquaintance who likes to listen and asks question after question
de-a1-freunde.openingTr: You talk about Murat so often. Who is that?
de-a1-freunde.goal: Where your friend lives, what they do and how often you meet have all been described.

de-a1-nicht.scene: A member of staff at an office is giving you directions very fast and you are missing half of it. Say that you have not understood, ask them to slow down, and correct something they have got wrong.
de-a1-nicht.partner: a hurried but well-meaning member of staff
de-a1-nicht.openingTr: You need form A and then room twelve, all right?
de-a1-nicht.goal: The part you missed has been repeated, the wrong information has been put right and it is clear what you have to do.

de-a1-familienfest.scene: You are planning Saturday's family gathering with your cousin. Talk about who is coming and decide who is bringing what.
de-a1-familienfest.partner: a cousin who lists everything and loves planning
de-a1-familienfest.openingTr: On Saturday we're celebrating together. Who's all coming?
de-a1-familienfest.goal: Who is coming, who is bringing what and what time you are meeting have all been settled.

de-a1-cafe.scene: You are sitting in a café and the waiter has come to take your order. Order something with the pattern 'Ich möchte …', make small talk, and ask for the bill at the end.
de-a1-cafe.openingTr: Good afternoon! What would you like to order?
de-a1-cafe.goal: The order has been placed, it has arrived at the table and the bill has been asked for.

de-a1-fruehstueck.scene: You are at the breakfast table with your flatmate. Say what you want to eat and drink, ask what else is on the table, and say what you like at breakfast.
de-a1-fruehstueck.partner: a flatmate who is cheerful in the mornings and talks a lot
de-a1-fruehstueck.openingTr: Good morning! What do you eat for breakfast?
de-a1-fruehstueck.goal: You have both said what you will eat and drink, and found something missing from the table.

de-a1-imbiss.scene: You are at a snack bar on your lunch break and there is a queue behind you. Give your order in short sentences, ask the price, and say whether you are eating in or taking it away.
de-a1-imbiss.partner: a quick-handed, jokey snack bar owner
de-a1-imbiss.openingTr: Hello! Would you like sausage or chips?
de-a1-imbiss.goal: The order has been given, the price has been said and it is settled whether you eat in or take it away.

de-a1-restaurant.scene: You have sat down at a table in a restaurant and the waiter has come to take your order. Ask for the menu, choose a starter, say your main course and ask to pay at the end.
de-a1-restaurant.partner: a calm waiter who knows exactly what to recommend
de-a1-restaurant.openingTr: Good evening! Would you like to order now?
de-a1-restaurant.goal: A starter and a main course have been chosen, and the bill has been asked for at the end.

de-a1-lieblingsessen.scene: You are talking with a colleague on your lunch break about where to go to eat. Say what you like eating, state your preference between two options, and ask what they like.
de-a1-lieblingsessen.partner: a colleague who is very keen on food
de-a1-lieblingsessen.openingTr: I like eating vegetables. And what do you like eating?
de-a1-lieblingsessen.goal: What you both like eating has been talked about and you have decided where to go at lunchtime.

de-a1-supermarkt.scene: You are shopping in a supermarket but you cannot find a few of the things you are after. Say what you need, ask where the products are, and ask about something they do not have.
de-a1-supermarkt.partner: a helpful but hurried shop assistant
de-a1-supermarkt.openingTr: Good afternoon! Are you looking for something?
de-a1-supermarkt.goal: You have found out where the products you wanted are, and been offered another solution for the one they did not have.

de-a1-mengen.scene: You are shopping at a greengrocer's. Say what you want along with the quantity, add a few more things, and ask the price.
de-a1-mengen.partner: a chatty greengrocer who is proud of the stall
de-a1-mengen.openingTr: The tomatoes are fresh today. How much would you like?
de-a1-mengen.goal: What you asked for has been weighed out by the quantity you gave, and the total has been said.

de-a1-kochen.scene: You are making dinner with a friend in their kitchen. Talk about what you will make: say what you are chopping, ask them to do something, and ask about a missing ingredient.
de-a1-kochen.partner: a messy friend who talks a lot in the kitchen
de-a1-kochen.openingTr: I've got tomatoes and onions. What are we cooking today?
de-a1-kochen.goal: Who is doing what has been shared out, and a solution has been found for the missing ingredient.

de-a1-allergie.scene: You are queueing in the staff canteen and today's dish may contain something you cannot eat. Say what you do not eat, explain your allergy, and ask whether there is an option without that ingredient.
de-a1-allergie.partner: a patient cook who likes describing the food
de-a1-allergie.openingTr: Today there's soup and sausage. What would you like?
de-a1-allergie.goal: You have said what you cannot eat and an option that suits you has been found.

de-a1-einladung-essen.scene: You are invited to dinner at a German friend's home and you have just sat down at the table. Accept or politely decline what you are offered, praise the food, and offer your host something too.
de-a1-einladung-essen.partner: an insistent host who will not let a guest leave hungry
de-a1-einladung-essen.openingTr: Welcome! Would you like some soup first?
de-a1-einladung-essen.goal: What was offered has been discussed, the food has been praised and thanks have been given as you leave the table.

de-a1-mein-tag.scene: You are new in your job and chatting with a colleague on your lunch break. Describe how your day goes: what time it starts, when you work, what you do in the evening.
de-a1-mein-tag.partner: a friendly colleague who enjoys a chat
de-a1-mein-tag.openingTr: Tell me, when does your day start? Do you get up early?
de-a1-mein-tag.goal: The start of your day, your working hours and your evening have been described, and your colleague has said something about their own day.

de-a1-uhrzeit.scene: Someone asks you the time while you are waiting at a stop. Say the time, then ask them what time the train comes. Try to use the half hours.
de-a1-uhrzeit.partner: a polite passenger who is in a hurry
de-a1-uhrzeit.openingTr: Excuse me, what time is it, please?
de-a1-uhrzeit.goal: The time has been given and you have found out when the train arrives.

de-a1-trennbar.scene: You are planning tomorrow with a friend. Say what time you will get up and when you will go shopping, and invite them to come with you. Use separable verbs.
de-a1-trennbar.partner: a friend who leaves everything to the last minute
de-a1-trennbar.openingTr: Hello! Are you getting up early tomorrow or having a lie-in?
de-a1-trennbar.goal: What time you are getting up and when you are going shopping have been settled, and your friend has said whether they are coming.

de-a1-wochentage.scene: You are signing up at a gym and discussing with the assistant which day and time you will come. Give the days and times with the right prepositions.
de-a1-wochentage.partner: a gym assistant who is trying to be helpful
de-a1-wochentage.openingTr: Good afternoon! Which days would you like to come?
de-a1-wochentage.goal: Which day and time you are coming has been agreed and the assistant has noted it down.

de-a1-v2.scene: You are at a language course and your teacher is asking when you study. Begin your answers with 'today', 'tomorrow' and 'at the weekend' — that is exactly where the rule has to be used.
de-a1-v2.partner: a curious and encouraging language teacher
de-a1-v2.openingTr: Good to have you here! When do you most like studying German?
de-a1-v2.goal: You have said what you will do today, tomorrow and at the weekend, and the teacher has approved your study plan.

de-a1-morgenroutine.scene: Your flatmate is asking why you leave so late in the mornings. Describe your morning routine step by step: what you do first, then what, and after that.
de-a1-morgenroutine.partner: a flatmate who gets up very early
de-a1-morgenroutine.openingTr: You're late again! What takes you so long in the mornings?
de-a1-morgenroutine.goal: Your morning routine has been described from start to finish and the reason you leave late has been found.

de-a1-arbeitstag.scene: A colleague who has just joined the office is asking about the working hours. Say what time work starts, what time it ends and when you take your breaks.
de-a1-arbeitstag.partner: a slightly shy colleague who has just started
de-a1-arbeitstag.openingTr: Sorry, when does work actually start here?
de-a1-arbeitstag.goal: Your working hours and your breaks have been described, and your new colleague has told you their own hours.

de-a1-feierabend.scene: At the end of a tiring day at work a friend is asking you out for the evening. Say what you would rather do and explain your reasons.
de-a1-feierabend.partner: an energetic friend, determined to get you out of the house
de-a1-feierabend.openingTr: Finally, home time! Are you coming along or staying in?
de-a1-feierabend.goal: You have decided what to do in the evening, or politely let it go.

de-a1-wochenende-plan.scene: It is Friday evening and you are talking about the weekend with a friend. Say what you are doing on each day, and use the word for 'maybe' for the plans that are not fixed.
de-a1-wochenende-plan.partner: a friend who loves making weekend plans
de-a1-wochenende-plan.openingTr: Have you got any plans for the weekend yet?
de-a1-wochenende-plan.goal: Your Saturday and Sunday plans have been given and you have decided to do one thing together.

de-a1-zeit-haben.scene: A friend is ringing you and wants to meet this week. Say which day and time suit you, and say no politely to a day that does not.
de-a1-zeit-haben.partner: a friend who is not pushy but wants to settle it soon
de-a1-zeit-haben.openingTr: Hello! Have you got time for a coffee this week?
